system.description:
Adopt a distinct form that reflects a different suite of traits. Serves story and theme; coordinate details with your GM.

  • Level 1: 5 CP for alternate form
  • Level 2: 6-10 CP for alternate form
  • Level 3: 11-15 CP for alternate form
  • Level 4: 16-20 CP for alternate form
  • Level 5: 21-25 CP for alternate form
  • Level 6: 26-30 CP for alternate form
